mantra.line: Everything ORANGE built since 9/3 was built for this. The only thing missing is one word, and it has been missing for a week.
One decision, D-9, gates seven. Rule it and the design pass runs the same session.

items.t: **D-1 Ultrasin is the studio; she is the first signing.** Brand shape: a photo studio, not one person, launched persona-first.
**D-2 canon age 21, chart-first birth date.** Rail: canon age 18 or over in every render, bio and beat.
**D-3 the fictional arc mirrors the real arc.** The unbuffered-cohort baddie; the attitude is the product, not the X-rated value.
**D-4 Season 1 = signed and shooting; Season 2 = the friend.** A storyline rides it: bottom to top is her season.

items.t: **Fifteen creator cases and a synthesis** ([[bolo45|BOLO 45]]): the borrowed playbook; [[r9|R9]] proposed as the first gate (thirty days on a fresh X account, zero cost).
**The [[register|performer register]]**, 155 names, the source of taste ([[bolo42|BOLO 42]]).
**[[darkroom|DARKROOM]] 1.1 with the tag rail** ([[bolo44|BOLO 44]]): the reference layer for pose, light and composition; ADORNED landed today.
**The [[ultra-dark|ULTRA DARK]] funnel** ([[ultra-dark|BOLO 27]]): Blocks A and B done; [[block-c|Block C]] "marked" is the hands-on work behind this launch.
**The brief v0.1** on the project flow: end state, seven workstreams, seven gates, eight assumptions, the deny list. Becomes v1.0 when you word D-10 and clear D-9.

**D-9 converted from a boresight to a HOLD on 9/4 with no date.** The flow allows three answers: clear, a dated hold, NO-GO. An undated hold is the [[stall-pattern|stall pattern]] by name: a finished design blocked on one unanswered decision.
**Six decisions ride on it:** D-5 the nut · D-6 the frame · D-7 the loss · D-8 the reference method · D-10 the intent · D-11 the lane.

phases.t: **Boresight walked** over four transmissions; PIRs answered; holdings mapped.
**The brief ruled** — D-9 cleared GO 9/16, staged. D-10 still drafted, not worded; the draft stands.

**The design set** — the three no-dependency items landed 9/16 (benchmark read · Blender COA · reference-pull spec). D-6 and D-7 both ruled 9/16: **the character sheet builds now** (12-layer lite · TCVM · sex menu · Fantasy Drive · chart-first birth date · the death date · the dropout · the eviction). The gates table waits on D-5.
**The vertical slice** — one complete still set at target quality plus one week of posting to the grammar on a test account; AAR.
**Launch** — library banked (twenty to forty pieces plus a sixty-to-ninety-day buffer), accounts live, Season 1 begins.
**Monthly gates** for three months; first on-target month.
**Exit threshold or kill criterion**; AAR; the Season 2 decision.

coord: Workstreams: W1 character · W2 season · W3 studio frame · W4 look · W5 pipeline · W6 numbers · W7 distribution.
Out of scope: video, live streaming, any real-performer content, spend beyond the stretch, undisclosed passing as human, anyone under 18 in canon or render.
Deny list: ACTUAL's identity, location, employer history, finances; the real reference accounts' identities (composite, never clone); the studio's internal tooling; anything under _PRIVATE/.
Disruptions planned: platform action → second platform live from day one plus an owned hub; discovery throttle → SFW funnel account.
